fatal_blockers: Q1 is not supplied by the surviving NAND experiment. That verifier proves only a determinant-one binary module with legal energy 8 and false energies at least 56; it proves neither an explicit quaternion defect map, exact nonzero P-membership, grade-zero exclusion, nor any COPY tile.

Q2 lacks a defined linear transfer mechanism. Quaternion multiplication is bilinear when both factors vary, whereas ordinary CVP coordinates impose linear maps; the roadmap must exhibit fixed integral left/right multipliers and prove that every adverse class has finite valuation and maps nontrivially from gr_P^a to gr_P^{a+1}, including both Frobenius parities.

Q3 proves only Boolean circuit semantics, not unrestricted lattice soundness. An arbitrary signed, DROP, or non-Boolean seam state need not contain a Boolean false-output chain, as demonstrated by G5, G19, Goal G1, and the affine/parity attacks; Q1-Q2 must classify every reachable adverse boundary class, not merely false Boolean words.

Q4 is conditional on a nonzero defect of exact growing valuation. Membership in P^d alone permits zero, and cancellation or an unclassified seam can erase the associated-graded leading term; the norm theorem cannot repair this missing transfer invariant.

M2 has no supporting mechanism and is plausibly false at the completeness-scale shell: many independent constant-cost bag defects can generally have extensive support. The fixed Generation-38 B+64 shell cannot establish an O(log S) asymptotic support bound, while M4 merely postulates the strict recurrence already violated in G28.

T2-T4 misuse E-type unless substantial new bridges are proved. Kitaoka controls shortest nonzero vectors of a full homogeneous tensor product, not affine target cosets, formula-dependent contractions, sublattices, or the claim that one adverse circuit path multiplies every tensor factor; zero-layer and multiple-layer vectors remain fatal.

T5 does not justify c=1/500 because the unspecified poly(S) factor can invalidate the exponent comparison. More generally, the obstruction audit repeatedly labels proposed saturation, parity escape, DROP control, and all-depth rigidity as achieved although they are precisely the unproved frontier lemmas.
evidence: The supplied Goal-directed Generation-12 verifier reports 13,457 saturated N=8 NAND signature survivors and best energies 8 versus 56, but explicitly states that COPY, depth-two growth, and recursive filtration remain open. This supports only the roadmap's local-energy claim.

Goal-directed Generation 11 found grade-zero signed pseudosections in the canonical F_289 NAND template with energy 16 below the prime-ideal threshold 34. Thus grade-zero exclusion must be rerun on the redundant NAND itself and cannot be inferred from its larger Euclidean false energy.

G28 obtained lambda=57/32 below legal growth 2; G32 produced exactly additive compatible parity at cost 2d_1^2; G37 proved a universal delta<=0 cut. These are direct warnings that finite local separation does not imply strict composition.

G19 and Goal G1 exhibit exact signed accepting flows and diagonal embeddings satisfying all emitted linear coherence rows. Although Strategy 1 is not Barrington flow, the evidence refutes the roadmap's unsupported inference that naming a noncommutative algebra automatically excludes signed splicing.
Generation 38 proves only a fixed twelve-bag shell exclusion through B+64 and expressly supplies no logarithmic localization or gap recurrence. It does not verify M2-M4.

G30 proves seed isometry for the tested tensor construction, while Goal G8 and the D4/E6 runs repeatedly expose DROP, midpoint, and malformed-layer failures before amplification. No supplied verifier supports T2's affine homogenization gate or T3's tensor-network semantics.
next_experiment: Freeze an explicit maximal-order basis, P and uniformizer, the integral redundant-NAND defect map, every glue matrix, Euclidean objective, and a finite N<=8 COPY search space. First audit the NAND alone and every COPY candidate by exact residue-field elimination plus integral SNF, covering DROP and all malformed field boundary classes, and require each adverse fiber to have a nonzero leading P-class. Then exhaust both NAND-COPY orientations and both filtration/Frobenius parities, rejecting on any grade-zero adverse realization, zero leading class, valuation nonincrease, or signed seam shortcut. A pass is only finite authorization to formulate Q2, not an all-depth result.
